source_refs.note: Roman Urdu: the Chapter 4 exercise solved (PDF 128-129), MCQ keys worked out from the chapter.

blocks.text: Yeh chapter 4 (Biomolecules) ki exercise hai, kitab ki tarteeb mein, hal ke saath. Har MCQ ke saath sahi jawab aur wajah hai (kitab MCQs ki key nahi deti); short, long aur inquisitive sawalon ke model jawab (poore number wale) diye gaye hain. Jahan zaroorat hai, "Wazahat" box mein aasan alfaaz mein samjhaya gaya hai.
Section 1: Multiple Choice Questions (kai jawabon mein se sahi chunein)

blocks.prompt: 1. Which domain of life is characterized by organisms that often inhabit extreme environments and have cell membranes with ether-linked lipids?
blocks.explanation: Archaea aksar sakht mahol (garam chashme, bohat namkeen pani) mein rehte hain aur un ki cell membrane mein ether-linked lipids hote hain; Bacteria aur Eukarya mein ester-linked lipids hote hain. (Yeh Chapter 1 ka sawal hai jo yahan dobara aaya hai.)

blocks.prompt: 2. Which characteristic of water molecules is responsible for most of the unique properties of water?

options.text: Can easily separate from one another

blocks.explanation: Pani ke molecules hydrogen bonds se aapas mein chipakte hain (cohesion). Pani ki zyada tar khaas properties (high specific heat, high heat of vaporization, cohesion, surface tension, barf ka tairna) inhi hydrogen bonds ki wajah se hain (4.4).

blocks.prompt: 3. To which group of lipids, the human sex hormones belong?
blocks.explanation: Animal cells cholesterol (steroid) se doosre steroids banate hain, maslan male aur female sex hormones (4.7). Is liye jawab Steroid hai.

blocks.prompt: 4. Which of the following is NOT a protein?
blocks.explanation: Cholesterol steroid hai yaani lipid. Haemoglobin (oxygen le jane wala), pepsin (enzyme) aur antibody sab proteins hain.

blocks.prompt: 5. Which one is the largest carbohydrate?
blocks.explanation: Cellulose polysaccharide hai jo bohat se beta-glucose units se bana hai. Ribose (pentose), glyceraldehyde (triose) aur glucose (hexose) sirf aik aik monosaccharide hain.

blocks.prompt: 6. What compound would be manufactured difficultly when soil has a shortage of phosphorous?
blocks.explanation: DNA ke har nucleotide mein phosphate group (phosphoric acid) hota hai aur sugar-phosphate backbone inhein jorti hai. Fatty acids aur cellulose (C, H, O) aur proteins (C, H, O, N, S) ko phosphorus ki zaroorat nahi.

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Sawal mein "phosphorous" chhapa hai; element ka sahi spelling "phosphorus" hai. Sawal ka matlab: mitti mein phosphorus kam ho to kaun sa compound mushkil se banega?

blocks.prompt: 7. A compound whose chemical composition is most closely related to maltose is;
blocks.explanation: Maltose do glucose units ka 1,4-glycosidic bond se jora hai; starch bhi bohat se glucose units ki 1,4 linkages wali chain hai. Amylase starch ko maltose mein torta hai, is liye dono ki banawat sab se milti hai.

blocks.prompt: 8. Which group is found in all fatty acids?
blocks.explanation: Fatty acids lambi hydrocarbon chains hain jin ke aakhir mein carboxyl (-COOH) group hota hai (4.7).

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Option (a) "PO4" chhapa hai; is se muraad PO₄ (phosphate) hai.

blocks.prompt: 9. Haemoglobin has:
blocks.explanation: Haemoglobin chaar polypeptide chains (do alpha, do beta) se bana hai; har chain ki apni tertiary structure hai aur chaaron mil kar quaternary structure banati hain (4.6).

blocks.prompt: 10. Which process produces peptide bonds?
blocks.explanation: Aik amino acid ka carboxyl group aur doosre ka amino group judte hain aur pani ka aik molecule nikalta hai: yeh dehydration synthesis hai. Digestion aur hydrolysis peptide bond torte hain.

blocks.prompt:
1. Draw a sketch of hydrolysis reactions.
Hydrolysis reactions ka khaka (sketch) banayein.
blocks.explanation:
Hydrolysis mein pani daal kar polymer ko monomers mein tora jata hai: pani ka OH aik monomer se aur H doosre se jurta hai.
Sketch: Maltose + H₂O → Glucose + Glucose. Do glucose rings banayein jo O bridge (C1-O-C4) se jure hon; bond par teer se H₂O aata dikhayein, phir do alag glucose rings, aik ke C1 par OH aur doosre ke C4 par OH.
Doosri misalein: dipeptide + H₂O → 2 amino acids; triacylglycerol + 3H₂O → glycerol + 3 fatty acids.

blocks.prompt:
2. Draw the ring structure of glucose and fructose.
Glucose aur fructose ka ring structure banayein.
blocks.explanation:
Glucose: chhe kono wala pyran ring (5 C + 1 O); O bridge C1 aur C5 ke darmiyan. C6 (CH₂OH) C5 se oopar nikla hota hai; C1-C4 par H aur OH (alpha-glucose mein C1 ka OH neeche).
Fructose: paanch kono wala furan ring (4 C + 1 O); O bridge C2 aur C5 ke darmiyan. C2 par C1 (CH₂OH) aur OH; C5 par C6 (CH₂OH).
Label: glucose = pyranose (aldose), fructose = furanose (ketose).

blocks.title: Wazahat
blocks.text: Yaad rakhne ka tareeqa: glucose ka ring 6 kono wala (pyran), fructose ka 5 kono wala (furan). Ring ke aik kone par hamesha oxygen hota hai.

blocks.prompt:
3. Define isomers and stereoisomers.
Isomers aur stereoisomers ki tareef karein.
blocks.explanation:
Isomers (hum-formula molecules): jin ka molecular formula aik ho magar atoms ki tarteeb (structural formula) mukhtalif ho, maslan glucose aur fructose (C₆H₁₂O₆).
Stereoisomers: aise isomers jin ka structural formula aik ho, sirf kisi group ka rukh (orientation) mukhtalif ho, maslan glucose aur galactose mein carbon 4 ke OH ka rukh (alpha aur beta glucose mein carbon 1 ka).

blocks.prompt:
4. Draw the sketch of amino acid.
Amino acid ka sketch banayein.
blocks.explanation:
Beech mein alpha carbon (C) banayein jis ke chaar bonds hon: baen taraf amino group (NH₂), daen taraf carboxyl group (COOH), neeche hydrogen (H) aur oopar side group (R).
Aam formula: NH₂-CH(R)-COOH. Misal: glycine mein R = H, alanine mein R = CH₃.

blocks.prompt:
5. Outline the synthesis of peptide linkages.
Peptide linkage banne ka khulasa likhein.
blocks.explanation:
Do amino acids qareeb aate hain; aik ka carboxyl group (COOH) doosre ke amino group (NH₂) se dehydration synthesis (pani nikaal kar jorna) se react karta hai.
COOH ka OH aur NH₂ ka H mil kar H₂O ban kar nikalte hain, aur C aur N ke darmiyan peptide bond (-CO-NH-) banta hai.
Misal: glycine + alanine → glycylalanine (dipeptide) + H₂O; mazeed amino acids se polypeptide banti hai.

blocks.prompt:
6. Draw the sketch of acylglycerol, phospholipid and terpene.
Acylglycerol, phospholipid aur terpene ka sketch banayein.
blocks.explanation:
Acylglycerol (triacylglycerol): khari glycerol backbone (3 carbons); har carbon ester bond (-O-CO-) se aik lambi fatty acid chain se jura, shakal angrezi harf E jaisi.
Phospholipid (maslan lecithin): glycerol ke do carbons par do fatty acid tails (non-polar, pani se door bhagne wali); teesre carbon par phosphate aur us se jura nitrogenous base (choline), yeh polar head hai. Head (hydrophilic) aur tails (hydrophobic) ke labels lagayein.
Terpene: isoprene units se banta hai, CH₂=C(CH₃)-CH=CH₂; do ya zyada isoprene units chain mein jure dikhayein (maslan vitamin A, rubber).

blocks.prompt:
7. Differentiate between nucleoside and nucleotide.
Nucleoside aur nucleotide mein farq bataein.
blocks.explanation: Nucleoside = base + sugar; nucleotide = nucleoside + phosphate.

rows: Nitrogenous base + pentose sugar
Nitrogenous base + pentose sugar + phosphoric acid
Base sugar ke carbon 1 se jurta hai
Phosphate ester linkage se sugar ke carbon 5 par jurta hai
Nucleic acid ki unit nahi
DNA aur RNA ki unit (monomer)
Misal: adenosine
Misal: AMP, ATP

blocks.prompt:
8. Illustrate the formation of phosphodiester bond.
Phosphodiester bond banne ko wazeh karein.
blocks.explanation:
Nucleotide mein phosphoric acid sugar ke C-5 se ester linkage se jura hota hai.
Yehi phosphate agle nucleotide ki sugar ke C-3 ke OH se doosri ester linkage banata hai (pani nikalta hai).
Aik phosphate ki do ester linkages (C-5 aur C-3) phosphodiester bond kehlati hain; yeh baar baar ban kar sugar-phosphate backbone banati hain jis ke aik sire par 5' phosphate aur doosre par 3' OH azaad hota hai.

blocks.prompt:
9. State the central dogma of gene expression.
Gene expression ka central dogma bayan karein.
blocks.explanation:
Genetic maloomat DNA se RNA aur RNA se protein tak jaati hai.
DNA → RNA: transcription (gene ki RNA copy banna); RNA → protein: translation (RNA ki maloomat se protein banna).
Is tarah DNA cell ki properties aur kaam control karta hai.

blocks.prompt:
1. Distinguish carbohydrates, proteins, lipids and nucleic acids as the four fundamental biological molecules.
Carbohydrates, proteins, lipids aur nucleic acids ko chaar bunyadi biological molecules ke taur par alag alag wazeh karein.
blocks.explanation: Carbohydrates, proteins, lipids aur nucleic acids zindagi ke bunyadi organic molecules hain; mil kar protoplasm ke dry mass ka 93% banate hain (proteins 50%, nucleic acids 18%, carbohydrates 15%, lipids 10%). Carbohydrates, proteins aur nucleic acids polymers hain jo dehydration synthesis se bante aur hydrolysis se toot-te hain; lipids asal polymers nahi.

blocks.prompt:
2. Describe and draw sketches of dehydration synthesis reactions.
Dehydration synthesis reactions bayan karein aur un ke sketch banayein.
blocks.explanation:
Dehydration synthesis (condensation): do monomers ko jorne ke liye aik se OH aur doosre se H nikalta hai; dono mil kar pani ka aik molecule ban jate hain. Is mein energy lagti hai, is liye cell ko macromolecules banane ke liye energy deni parti hai. Yeh hydrolysis ka ulat hai.
Sketches (har aik ko reactants → product + H₂O ki shakal mein banayein, nikalne wale OH aur H par daira lagayein):
1. Carbohydrate: Glucose + Glucose → Maltose + H₂O. Do glucose rings; pehle ke C1 ka OH aur doosre ke C4 ke OH ka H nikalta hai; rings O bridge (1,4-glycosidic bond) se jurte hain.
2. Protein: Amino acid + Amino acid → Dipeptide + H₂O (glycine + alanine → glycylalanine). Aik ke COOH ka OH aur doosre ke NH₂ ka H nikalta hai; peptide bond (-CO-NH-) banta hai.
3. Lipid: Glycerol + 3 Fatty acids → Triacylglycerol + 3H₂O. Glycerol ke har OH ka H aur har COOH ka OH nikalta hai; teen ester bonds bante hain.
4. Nucleic acid: Nucleotide + Nucleotide → Dinucleotide + H₂O; aik ke C-5 wala phosphate agle ke C-3 OH se jurta hai (phosphodiester bond).
Yeh reactions baar baar ho kar polysaccharides, polypeptides aur polynucleotides banati hain.

blocks.prompt:
3. Explain how the properties of water make it the medium of life.
Wazeh karein ke pani ki properties use zindagi ka medium (zariya) kaise banati hain.
blocks.explanation:
Jandaron ka 65-89% pani hai; is ki polarity aur hydrogen bonds ki wajah se yeh properties zindagi ko sahara deti hain:
1. Behtareen solvent (ghulne wala) — polarity: pani ke molecules ions (Na⁺, Cl⁻) ko gher lete hain aur polar molecules (glucose) se hydrogen bonds banate hain, is liye yeh ghul jate hain. Ghule hue molecules aasani se react karte hain, is liye pani metabolism ka medium hai.
2. Hydrophobic exclusion (pani se bahar dhakelna): pani non-polar molecules (lipids) ko bahar dhakelta hai, woh aapas mein jurte hain; is se cell membranes banti aur qaim rehti hain.
3. High specific heat capacity (4.184 J g⁻¹ °C⁻¹): garmi zyada tar hydrogen bonds torne mein lagti hai, is liye pani der se garam aur der se thanda hota hai aur jandaron ka darja-e-hararat (temperature) mustaqil rakhta hai.
4. High heat of vaporization (574 kcal/kg): bhaap banne mein bohat garmi nikalti hai; transpiration aur paseene se thandak milti hai aur zameen ka temperature mutadil rehta hai.
5. Cohesion aur surface tension: hydrogen bonds pani ke molecules ko jore rakhte hain, is liye pani xylem mein jaron se pattiyon tak khinchta hai; surface tension ki wajah se water strider pani par chalta hai.
6. Ionization: pani H⁺ aur OH⁻ banata hai (khalis pani mein har aik 10⁻⁷ mol/L); yeh hydrolysis jaisi reactions mein hissa lete hain aur pH tay karte hain jo enzymes ke liye zaroori hai.
7. 4 °C par sab se zyada density: barf halki ho kar tairti hai aur neeche ke pani ko thanda hone se bachati hai, is liye aabi jandar sardi mein zinda rehte hain.

blocks.prompt:
4. Distinguish the properties and roles of monosaccharides and classify them.
Monosaccharides ki properties aur kaam bayan karein aur un ki darja bandi (classification) karein.
blocks.explanation:
Monosaccharides saada sugars hain jo sirf aik sugar molecule se bani hoti hain.
Properties:
- 3 se 7 carbon atoms; aam formula (CH₂O)n, maslan glucose C₆H₁₂O₆.
- Meethi, crystal wali aur pani mein aasani se ghulne wali.
- Aldehyde group (aldose, maslan glucose) ya keto group (ketose, maslan fructose).
- Isomerism dikhati hain (glucose, fructose, galactose isomers hain).
- Mehlool (solution) mein zyada tar ring banati hain: glucose aur galactose chhe kono wala pyran ring (C1-C5 bridge); fructose (C2-C5) aur ribose (C1-C4) paanch kono wala furan ring.
Kaam:
- Glucose energy ka bunyadi zariya aur respiratory fuel hai; hexoses C-H bonds mein energy rakhti hain.
- Ribose aur deoxyribose RNA, DNA aur ATP ka hissa; ribulose (RuBP ki shakal mein) photosynthesis mein CO₂ pakarti hai.
- Trioses (glyceraldehyde) glycolysis aur photosynthesis ke intermediates (darmiyani molecules) hain.
- Yeh disaccharides aur polysaccharides ke monomers hain.
Classification (carbon atoms ki tadaad se):
- Trioses (3C, C₃H₆O₃): glyceraldehyde, dihydroxyacetone
- Tetroses (4C, C₄H₈O₄): erythrose, erythrulose
- Pentoses (5C, C₅H₁₀O₅): ribose, deoxyribose (C₅H₁₀O₄), ribulose
- Hexoses (6C, C₆H₁₂O₆): glucose, fructose, galactose
- Heptoses (7C, C₇H₁₄O₇): kam milti hain (photosynthesis ke intermediates)

blocks.prompt:
5. Compare the structural isomers and stereoisomers of glucose.
Glucose ke structural isomers aur stereoisomers ka muqabla karein.
blocks.explanation: Dono ka formula C₆H₁₂O₆ hai: structural isomers mein atoms ka jorr mukhtalif hota hai, stereoisomers mein sirf kisi OH group ka rukh.

rows: Molecular formula aik, structural formula mukhtalif
Structural formula aik, kisi group ka rukh mukhtalif
Misal: glucose aur fructose
Misal: glucose aur galactose; alpha aur beta glucose
Glucose: C=O kinare wale carbon 1 par (aldose); fructose: C=O andar wale carbon 2 par (ketose)
Glucose aur galactose mein carbon 4 ke OH ka rukh mukhtalif
Rings mukhtalif: glucose pyran (6 kone, C1-C5); fructose furan (5 kone, C2-C5)
Alpha-glucose: C1 ka OH ring ke neeche; beta-glucose: C1 ka OH oopar
Functional group mukhtalif, is liye chemical properties mukhtalif
Groups wohi; chhota farq polymer badal deta hai: alpha se starch, beta se cellulose

blocks.prompt:
6. Distinguish the properties and roles of disaccharides.
Disaccharides ki properties aur kaam wazeh karein.
blocks.explanation:
Disaccharides do monosaccharides ke dehydration synthesis se jurne se banti hain.
Properties:
- Do units covalent glycosidic bond se jure hote hain.
- Hydrolysis par apni monosaccharides wapas deti hain.
- Meethi, magar monosaccharides se kam ghulne wali.
Aham disaccharides aur un ke kaam:
1. Maltose (malt sugar): glucose + glucose, 1,4-glycosidic bond. Ghallon (gandum, makai) mein milti hai aur starch ke hazam hone mein banti hai; hazam ho kar glucose (energy) deti hai.
2. Lactose (doodh ki sugar): galactose 1-4 glucose. Sirf mammals ke doodh mein; chhote bachon ki energy ka bara zariya.
3. Sucrose (cheeni, table sugar): glucose 1-2 fructose, C₁₂H₂₂O₁₁. Meetha karne ke liye; paudon ke phloem mein sugar ko aik jagah se doosri jagah le jati hai, is liye transport disaccharide kehlati hai.

blocks.title: Wazahat
blocks.text: Chapter ke matan (text) mein sucrose ka formula C₁₁H₂₂O₁₁ chhapa hai jo ghalat hai; sahi C₁₂H₂₂O₁₁ hai (do hexoses C₆H₁₂O₆ + C₆H₁₂O₆ se aik H₂O nikalta hai). Exam mein C₁₂H₂₂O₁₁ likhein.

blocks.prompt:
7. Define proteins and amino acids and outline the synthesis and breakage of peptide linkages.
Proteins aur amino acids ki tareef karein aur peptide linkage ke banne aur tootne ka khulasa likhein.
blocks.explanation:
Proteins: amino acids ke polymers jo peptide bonds se jure hote hain; aik ya zyada polypeptide chains (insulin 2, haemoglobin 4). Yeh cell ke sab se zyada organic compounds aur zindagi ki building blocks hain.
Amino acid: protein ki bunyadi unit; aisa organic molecule jis mein amino group (NH₂), carboxyl group (COOH), hydrogen (H) aur side group (R) aik hi alpha carbon se jure hote hain. R se amino acid ki pehchan hoti hai (glycine R = H, alanine R = CH₃). Zyada tar proteins 20 amino acids se bante hain: 9 essential (khurak se) aur 11 non-essential (jism khud banata hai).
Peptide linkage ka banna (dehydration synthesis):
- Aik amino acid ka COOH agle ke NH₂ se react karta hai.
- COOH ka OH aur NH₂ ka H mil kar H₂O ban kar nikalte hain.
- C aur N ke darmiyan peptide bond (-CO-NH-) banta hai, maslan glycine + alanine → glycylalanine + H₂O.
- Dipeptide ke sire par phir NH₂ aur COOH azaad hote hain, is liye mazeed amino acids jur kar polypeptide banti hai.
Peptide linkage ka tootna (hydrolysis):
- Peptide bond par pani ka molecule daala jata hai: OH carbon ko (COOH wapas) aur H nitrogen ko (NH₂ wapas) milta hai.
- Dipeptide + H₂O → 2 amino acids. Digestion (hazam) mein proteases (pepsin, trypsin) aur peptidases isi tarah proteins torte hain.

blocks.prompt:
8. Justify the significance of the sequence of amino acids through the example of sickle cell haemoglobin.
Sickle cell haemoglobin ki misal se amino acids ki tarteeb (sequence) ki ahmiyat sabit karein.
blocks.explanation:
Har protein ki primary structure (amino acids ki tadaad, qisam aur tarteeb) bilkul makhsoos hoti hai aur DNA ke nucleotides ki tarteeb se tay hoti hai. Yehi tarteeb tay karti hai ke chain kaise mudegi, yaani protein ki shakal aur kaam. Zara si tabdeeli se protein kharab (abnormal) ho sakta hai.
Misal: haemoglobin mein chaar chains hain, do alpha (har aik mein 141 amino acids) aur do beta (har aik mein 146).
- Normal haemoglobin mein har beta chain ki chhati (6th) jagah par glutamic acid hota hai.
- Sickle cell haemoglobin mein us ki jagah valine aa jata hai: 146 mein se sirf aik amino acid ki ghalti.
- Is ghalat haemoglobin se red blood cells darranti (sickle) jaisi shakal ke ho jate hain aur kafi oxygen nahi le ja sakte.
- Natija: sickle cell anaemia ki bimari.
Nateeja: tarteeb mein sirf aik amino acid badalne se poore protein ki shakal aur kaam badal jata hai, is liye sahi tarteeb normal kaam ke liye zaroori hai.

blocks.prompt:
9. Describe the properties and roles of acylglycerols, phospholipids, terpenes and waxes.
Acylglycerols, phospholipids, terpenes aur waxes ki properties aur kaam bayan karein.
blocks.explanation:
1. Acylglycerols (fats aur oils)
- Glycerol (3C alcohol) aur fatty acids ke esters, dehydration synthesis se bante hain; triacylglycerol (aik glycerol par teen fatty acids) sab se aam (neutral lipids).
- Fats kamre ke temperature par thos (zyada tar janwaron mein, saturated fatty acids, seedhi chains, high melting point); oils maya (zyada tar paudon mein, unsaturated fatty acids double bonds ke saath, mudi hui chains, low melting point).
- Non-polar aur pani mein na ghulne wale.
- Kaam: bohat se C-H bonds ki wajah se energy ka behtareen zakheera (lipids 9.5 kcal/g); khaas jagahon par jama; jild ke neeche insulation (garmi sardi se bachao) aur aaza (organs) ki gaddi.
2. Phospholipids
- Phosphatidic acid (glycerol + 2 fatty acids + phosphate) se bane, saath nitrogenous base (choline, ethanolamine ya serine), maslan lecithin (phosphatidyl choline).
- Phosphate aur base ka polar (pani pasand) head aur do non-polar (pani se door) fatty acid tails.
- Kaam: plasma membrane ki lipid bilayer (do tehein) banate hain.
3. Terpenes
- Bara aur mukhtalif group jo isoprene units, CH₂=C(CH₃)-CH=CH₂, se bana hai.
- Kaam: aham pigments (rang) jaise chlorophyll (paudon mein) aur retinal (aankh mein); vitamin A aur rubber bhi terpenes hain.
4. Waxes (mom)
- Acylglycerols se bane; lambi chain wale alkanes (taaq carbons, 25-35), alcohols, ketones aur lambi fatty acids ka mixture.
- High melting point (kamre ke temperature par thos), chemically inert (react na karne wale) aur sakht hydrophobic.
- Kaam: phalon, pattiyon, keeron, parindon aur bheron par pani rok hifazati teh; kaan ka mail; shehd ki makhi ka chhatta; mom battiyan, polish, crayons aur waterproof kaghaz.

blocks.prompt:
10. Describe the molecular level structure of nucleotide.
Nucleotide ki molecular structure bayan karein.
blocks.explanation:
Nucleotide nucleic acids ka monomer hai; is ke teen hisse hain: nitrogenous base, pentose sugar aur phosphoric acid (nucleotide = nucleoside + phosphoric acid).
1. Pentose sugar: RNA mein ribose, DNA mein deoxyribose (paanch carbon wali sugar).
2. Nitrogenous base:
- Pyrimidines (aik ring): cytosine (C, DNA aur RNA dono), thymine (T, sirf DNA), uracil (U, sirf RNA).
- Purines (do rings): adenine (A) aur guanine (G), DNA aur RNA dono mein.
Base sugar ke carbon 1 se jur kar nucleoside banata hai.
3. Phosphoric acid: sugar ke carbon 5 par ester linkage se nucleoside se jurta hai aur nucleotide banta hai.
RNA ke nucleotides ribonucleotides aur DNA ke deoxyribonucleotides kehlate hain; har aik apne base ke naam se pukara jata hai. Nucleotides phosphodiester bonds (aik ka C-5 agle ke C-3 se) se jur kar sugar-phosphate backbone banate hain.
Doosre nucleotides: ATP (adenine + ribose + teen phosphates, energy ki currency) aur NAD (dinucleotide coenzyme, hydrogen lene wala).

blocks.prompt:
11. Explain the double helical structure of DNA as proposed by Watson and Crick.
Watson aur Crick ke pesh karda DNA ke double helix structure ki wazahat karein.
blocks.explanation:
1953 mein James Watson aur Francis Crick ne DNA ka model pesh kiya; is mein Rosalind Franklin aur Maurice Wilkins ka X-ray kaam aur Chargaff ka mushahida (A = T aur G = C) madadgar bana.
Model ke aham nukaat:
1. DNA do polynucleotide chains (strands) se bana hai.
2. Dono strands aik doosre ke gird lipat kar double helix (dohra pech) banate hain.
3. Helix mure hue seedhi (ladder) jaisa hai: is ke dande (sides) sugar aur phosphate se, aur paidan (rungs) nitrogenous base pairs se bane hain.
4. Har paidan mein aik purine aur aik pyrimidine: adenine thymine ke saath, guanine cytosine ke saath (complementary jora).
5. Strands bases ke darmiyan kamzor hydrogen bonds se jure hain: A aur T mein do, G aur C mein teen.
6. Dono strands phosphodiester linkages ke lehaz se ulti simt mein chalte hain (anti-parallel): aik 5'→3', doosra 3'→5'.
DNA virasati maadda hai; is ke genes (nucleotides ki tarteeb) cell ke tamaam kaam control karte hain.

blocks.title: Wazahat
blocks.text: Seedhi (ladder) ki misal yaad rakhein: dono kinare = sugar-phosphate, beech ke paidan = A-T aur G-C jore. Phir is seedhi ko rassi ki tarah marorein to double helix ban jata hai.

blocks.prompt:
12. Explain the general structure of RNA and differentiate between the three types of RNA.
RNA ki aam structure samjhayein aur RNA ki teen qismon mein farq bataein.
blocks.explanation: Aam structure: RNA ribonucleotides ki aik hi polynucleotide chain hai jo phosphodiester bonds se juri hoti hai. Is ki sugar ribose aur bases adenine, guanine, cytosine aur uracil hain (thymine ki jagah uracil). Yeh DNA par transcription se banti hai aur nucleolus, ribosomes aur cytosol mein milti hai. Har zinda cell mein is ki teen qismein hain:

blocks.prompt:
13. Define conjugated molecules and describe the roles of common conjugated molecules.
Conjugated molecules ki tareef karein aur aam conjugated molecules ke kaam bayan karein.
blocks.explanation:
Conjugated molecules mukhtalif qismon ke do ya zyada molecules ke milap se bante hain (maslan protein + carbohydrate).
1. Glycoproteins: protein + carbohydrate polymer, covalent bond se. Kaam: membranes ka banawati hissa; blood serum, cell ki ratoobaton (secretions), cartilage, aankh aur jild mein.
2. Glycolipids: lipid + carbohydrate, covalent bond se. Kaam: membranes ka banawati hissa.
3. Lipoproteins: lipid + protein, hydrophobic interactions se (covalent ya ionic bond nahi). Kaam: tamaam plasma membranes ka bunyadi dhancha; lipids khoon mein very low-density lipoproteins ki shakal mein le jaye jate hain.
4. Nucleoproteins: chromosome ka DNA + proteins, ionic bonds se (maslan histones DNA se jur kar nucleosomes banate hain). Kaam: eukaryotes mein chromosome ki banawat ko mazboot rakhte hain aur genes ke kaam (gene expression) ko control karne mein madad karte hain.

blocks.prompt:
1. What happens if even one amino acid is substituted for another in a polypeptide chain? Provide a specific example.
Agar polypeptide chain mein sirf aik amino acid bhi kisi doosre se badal jaye to kya hota hai? Aik khaas misal dein.
blocks.explanation:
Primary structure badal jati hai. Chunke tarteeb hi tay karti hai ke chain kaise mudegi (secondary, tertiary, quaternary structure), is liye protein ki shakal aur kaam badal sakta hai aur protein kharab ho jata hai.
Misal: sickle cell haemoglobin mein har beta chain ki 6th jagah par glutamic acid ki jagah valine aa jata hai. Red blood cells darranti jaise ho jate hain aur kafi oxygen nahi le ja sakte: sickle cell anaemia.
(Chapter se aage: agar naya amino acid bilkul milta julta ho ya ghair aham jagah par ho to protein shayad theek kaam karta rahe.)

blocks.prompt:
2. How does the three-dimensional structure of a protein relate to its function?
Protein ki teen-jihati (3D) structure ka us ke kaam se kya talluq hai?
blocks.explanation:
Protein apni bilkul durust 3D shakal ki wajah se kaam karta hai, aur yeh shakal us ki tarteeb se banti hai.
- Tarteeb (primary structure) mur kar alpha helix ya pleated sheet (secondary), phir ionic, hydrogen aur disulphide bonds se globular shakal (tertiary) banati hai; kai chains mil sakti hain (quaternary).
- Fibrous proteins (keratin, collagen) lambe resha (fibrils) bante hain, is liye mazboot aur na ghulne wale hain aur dhanche ka kaam karte hain.
- Globular proteins gol, sukre hue aur ghulne wale hain, is liye functional kaam karte hain: enzyme ki active site sirf apne substrate par fit hoti hai; antibody apne antigen par; haemoglobin ki chaar chains oxygen le jati hain.
- Shakal badal jaye (sickle cell jaisa aik ghalat amino acid, ya garmi ya pH se denaturation, Chapter 5) to protein ka kaam khatam ho jata hai.

blocks.prompt:
3. How do nucleic acids encode genetic information, and how is this information translated into proteins?
Nucleic acids genetic maloomat kaise mehfooz (encode) karte hain aur yeh maloomat proteins mein kaise badalti hai?
blocks.explanation:
Encoding: genetic maloomat DNA mein nucleotides (bases A, T, G, C) ki tarteeb ki shakal mein hoti hai. Gene DNA nucleotides ki aisi tarteeb hai jo aik polypeptide ka code deti hai; bases ki tarteeb amino acids ki tarteeb tay karti hai.
Expression (central dogma, DNA → RNA → protein):
1. Transcription: gene "ON" ho to DNA ki aik strand ke complementary mRNA copy banti hai (T ki jagah U).
2. mRNA yeh paigham DNA se ribosomes tak le jati hai.
3. Translation: ribosome (rRNA aur protein se bana) par tRNAs amino acids late hain; amino acids mRNA ki batai hui tarteeb mein rakh kar peptide bonds se jore jate hain aur polypeptide banti hai.
(Chapter se aage: mRNA ko teen teen bases ke groups, yaani codons, mein parha jata hai; har tRNA par milta julta anticodon hota hai.)
Phir protein mur kar apna kaam karta hai; is tarah DNA cell ki properties aur kaam control karta hai.

blocks.title: Wazahat
blocks.text: Misal: DNA aik recipe ki kitab hai, mRNA us recipe ki photocopy jo kitchen (ribosome) tak jati hai, tRNA saman (amino acids) lane wala, aur ribosome cook jo saman ko sahi tarteeb mein jor kar dish (protein) banata hai.
